pieces.name: east
pieces.notes: E block, N-S ridge near x 575 from about y 455 to 530, lit S hip face, N hip face dark; its W face is the big 859 sq ft 8/12 plane so the W eave is pushed to x 490 (v1 had 530)

pieces.name: west
pieces.notes: W block, E-W ridge near y 505, hipped at the W end near x 455, N face shallower (5 to 6/12) than S face (8/12) per LiDAR; NW quarter under tree shadow, the lit diagonal from (455,400) to (565,455) is the junction with the E block

exclude_notes: patio/deck south of the eave, eave at about y 630
chimney notch north of the eave
notes: Two intersecting 1-story hips. E block widened W to x 490, W block E edge pulled back to 560 so neither spans the other ridge. Doubt remains on the lit diagonal from the NW corner. Confidence medium-low.
